media.title: Alfred Piccaver — portrait, Bain News Service
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the tenor Alfred Piccaver.
media.publicCaption: Alfred Piccaver, the English-born tenor who led the Vienna State Opera for a quarter of a century. He took the lead in Abenteuer am Lido (1933), the Austrian musical comedy scored by Kaper and Jurmann and his one substantial film role.
media.publicCreditLine: Unknown photographer, Bain News Service; Library of Congress, George Grantham Bain Collection, ggbain.34250.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States under the PD-US tag on the Wikimedia Commons file. The photograph comes from the Library of Congress George Grantham Bain Collection, for which the Library records no known restrictions on publication. Neither the photographer nor the exact date is established; the Commons file gives the date as unknown, and the collection's Piccaver portraits are dated by the Library between 1910 and the 1920s.
